key_findings: ADAR3 is downregulated in CCI mice; intrathecal ADAR3 overexpression relieves allodynia, hyperalgesia and inflammation.
ADAR3 interacts with NLRP3 and decreases NLRP3, ASC, caspase1, IL-1β, IL-18 and GSDMD, suppressing pyroptosis.
